title: Train To Pakistan
desc: The film is set in Mano Majra, which is a quiet fictional village on the border of India and Pakistan, close to where the railway line crosses the Sutlej River. The film develops around the love affair of small-time dacoit Juggut Singh (Nirmal Pandey), with a local Muslim girl, Nooran (Smriti Mishra).

title: Raaz
desc: A large mansion situated in Nairobi, resounds with the shrieks of its owner Kumar - a young man of Indian origin. Night after night he is woken up by three dreams - a woeful melody of a damsel in distress.

title: Insaf Ka Tarazu
desc: Ramesh, a multi-millionaire, falls madly in love with Bharti. In the turnout of events, Bharti kills Ramesh. Watch the heart wrenching drama to know what compels her to take this dire step.

title: Sautela Bhai
desc: Tulsiram is a village teacher who is married to Saraswati and has a step-brother, Rajaram, who lives in Bombay. When Rajaram returns, Tulsiram wants him to marry someone he has chosen but he has already chosen a wife.

title: Insaf Apne Lahoo Se
desc: Mahendra Pratap marries Geeta, but asks Devilal, her first son, to leave the house. Later, Geeta gets arrested for murder due to her husband's false testimony and gives birth to another son in prison.
